code_examples.section: ltm rule command PSC user name
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PSC::user_name
       Get or set user name.

SYNOPSIS
       PSC::user_name (USERNAME)?

DESCRIPTION
       The PSC::user_name command gets the user name or sets the user name when the optional value is given.

       Syntax

       PSC::user_name

	   * Retrieve the user name.

       PSC::user_name 

	   * Set the user name.

RETURN VALUE
       Return the user name when no argument is given.

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
